{{Quote|Of course they were always looking to get rid of me. Only woman to head a security team on Serenno. Many said I couldn't hack it&hellip; Said I only got the job because my father was Count Adan's security chief before me. "''They''" say that the Count appointed me out of loyalty to my old man. Star-gas. My own father didn't think I could do the job.|Candra Tymon, to Jahan Cross|<ref name="AotE:HT4" />}}
A '''security team''' served [[House Dooku]], one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]]. The [[Candra Tymon's father|father]] of [[Candra Tymon]] served as a [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief of Security]] for [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]] before her. Adan Dooku appointed her as her [[Parent/Legends|father]]'s successor, despite the fact that many on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], including her father, doubted a woman could lead a security team. Wanting to assure everyone of her worth and championed by Adan Dooku, since her promotion, Candra has worked twice as hard to make good on Adan's faith in her.<ref name="AotE:HT4" />

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the security team engaged many [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that had [[Attack on the Windrunner|boarded]] the Dooku airship ''[[Windrunner/Legends|Windrunner]]'' in an attempt to capture [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]].<ref name="AotE:HT2">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]]</ref>

In the aftermath of the [[Jahan Cross]]'s [[Infiltration of The Spike|infiltration]] of [[Spike (Serenno)/Legends|the Spike]], Candra Tymon was removed from her position as Chief of Security of [[House Dooku]] due to her inability to protect [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Bron Dooku]] and the fact that [[Aveca Dunn]], Dooku's kidnapper, escaped from her [[Prison/Legends|prison]].<ref name="AotE:HT4" />
